# Test fixture sources

Every image in `tests/fixtures/` must be listed here (README §11).

- **Synthetic images** (generated by code: skin-coloured patches, gradients, colour casts): note the generator script.
- **Real face images:** only openly licensed images (record source URL, licence and author) or images the owner provides with documented consent. Never scrape faces from the internet.

## Rules for real face images

- Use them only to test the pipeline (face detection, landmarks, regions, quality gate). They are real, identifiable people.
- **Never publish analysis results about the person** (skin depth, undertone, recommendations) in issues, PRs, docs, `CALIBRATION.md` or screenshots. Assert on structure (a face was found, 478 landmarks, regions inside the face), not on that person's colour values.
- Don't use them in a way that suggests the person or their employer endorses the project (NASA media guidelines: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/).
- We still need more openly licensed portraits across the full range of skin depths (see `docs/DECISIONS.md` R-006).
